commands.stdout:
usage: run_pipeline.py [-h] --stage
                       {prepare,cache,probe,evidence,explain,zeroshot,r1,r2,r3,feedback,report}
                       [--config CONFIG] [--dry-run] [--r3-from {r2,feedback}]
                       [--stop-after STOP_AFTER] [--resume]
                       [--cache-kind {features,regions}] [--skip-images]

Track B pipeline. Run from trackb; paths in YAML are relative to trackb.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --stage {prepare,cache,probe,evidence,explain,zeroshot,r1,r2,r3,feedback,report}
  --config CONFIG
  --dry-run             Validate config and list prerequisite status; never
                        load models or write artifacts
  --r3-from {r2,feedback}
                        Start a new R3 cycle from R2 or the actual feedback
                        checkpoint
  --stop-after STOP_AFTER
                        Stop cleanly after this optimizer step; unchanged
                        config can resume
  --resume              Resume latest complete optimizer boundary; stage
                        config must match
  --cache-kind {features,regions}
  --skip-images         prepare only: freeze/check contracts without local
                        images; GPU data check remains pending
